'''Nurkolas''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who was a contact of [[Bareesh Fenn'ak Torill]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nurkolas appears in the missions entitled "Armed and Dangerous" and "Slave Raiding" for Republic allied players in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] game, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
